title: The design notes of docs/dev/design out of the published documentation
author: Claude-JG
description: The documents of docs/dev/design went into the documentation, which was not intended - they contain planning, not the current state of the implementation. Mention them once in the development section; they are used for development like the plans and logs of docs/revision and do not belong to the docs.
releaseNotes: The design notes of docs/dev/design are development records like the revision plans and logs: they are no longer part of the published documentation and are listed once in the developer section.
